# Configuration contract without values

## Server inputs without values — 2026-11-16

`DB_CONNECTION`, `DB_HOST`, `DB_PORT`, `DB_DATABASE`, `DB_USERNAME`, `DB_PASSWORD`; existing optional `DB_URL`, `DB_SOCKET`, `MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA` and connection options remain supported. Separate `CARTEIRA_DIGITAL_DB_*` and `COFRE_PACIENTE_MONGODB_*` connections require their own infrastructure settings.

Infrastructure supplies effective values through the existing configuration interface. This catalog includes no private address, credential, connection string or operational server path.

Reviewed 2026-11-04 from source declarations, without opening dotenv, credentials, runtime stores or signing files. Feature-specific requirements differ from application boot requirements. An env() reference alone does not prove a variable is globally required.

| Key / input | Contract |
| --- | --- |
| `MERCADO_PAGO_AMBIENTE` | Payment integration: exactly teste/producao; no implicit environment |
| `MERCADO_PAGO_PUBLIC_KEY` | Browser SDK public credential; no private access token here |
| `CHAVE_GERAR_LOGIN, APP_KEY` | Authentication/session secrets; no safe operational default |
| `JWT_SECRET_CARTEIRA_DIGITAL, BASIC_AUTH_USER_CARTEIRA_DIGITAL, BASIC_AUTH_PASS_CARTEIRA_DIGITAL, URL_CARTEIRA_DIGITAL` | Required for Wallet boundary; owner/path/body claims are additional checks |
| `JWT_SECRET_COFRE_PACIENTE, BASIC_AUTH_USER_COFRE_PACIENTE, BASIC_AUTH_PASS_COFRE_PACIENTE, URL_COFRE_PACIENTE` | Required for Cofre boundary |
| `FCM_ENABLED, FCM_PROJECT_ID, FCM_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH` | Optional push feature; enabling requires valid service-account configuration; never publish account data |

## Checked runtime semantics — 2026-11-10

A: checked declarations in `config/auth.php`, `config/panel_access.php`, `config/atendimentos.php`, `config/queue.php`, the guard, technical-session service and `docker/entrypoint.sh`. Required/optional status is feature-specific; no effective dotenv was read.

| Setting / source | Default or absence behavior | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AUTH_GUARD` / auth | web; driver redis-session, provider users | Product authorization also requires Redis resolution |
| `CHAVE_GERAR_LOGIN` / auth | No declared safe default; password service fails closed when absent | Private authentication secret |
| `ACCESS_EMAIL_TECNICAL_PANEL` / panel_access | No declared fallback; challenge TTL fixed at 600 seconds | Technical email confirmation, not product login |
| `SessaoPainelTecnico::TTL` | Fixed 90 seconds, not an environment switch; heartbeat extends existing key | Technical authorization fails closed on Redis error/expiry |
| `ATENDIMENTOS_FINALIZACAO_PERIODICA_HABILITADA` | false | Periodic finalization opt-in plus crypto readiness |
| `TEMPO_MINIMO_PRESENCA_ATENDIMENTO_SEGUNDOS` | 900 | Participation assessment default |
| `TEMPO_MAXIMO_PACIENTE_FALTA_SEGUNDOS` | 60 | Absence assessment default |
| `TOLERANCIA_ESTORNO_ATENDIMENTO_MINUTOS` | 5 | Assessment tolerance, not provider refund confirmation |
| `QUEUE_CONNECTION` / queue | database | Laravel jobs; distinct from explicit AMQP adapters |
| `VIVABEM_RUN_MIGRATIONS` / entrypoint | 1; only 0/1 accepted | Principal bootstrap may migrate; workers are separate roles |

The finance-monitor schedule is gated false in source despite configuration names existing. Presence, cookie, product authorization, technical session and challenge lifetimes must not be substituted for one another. The source inventory is not proof of valid deployed credentials, complete empty-value semantics or every optional integration being active.

[Current Cockpit](../operations/technical-cockpit.md), [current architecture](../architecture/overview.md) and [testing](../operations/backend-testing.md) provide checked consumers and limits. Update both languages and collection after defaults, readiness, guards or bootstrap roles change. No environment, key or startup action was changed/executed by this documentation update.
